name: Eventin – Events Addon for Elementor
author: Arraytics

sections.description:
Eventin Addon for Elementor turns the Eventin event management plugin into a complete set of drag-and-drop Elementor widgets, so you can design event landing pages, registration flows, and ticket sales pages visually inside the Elementor page builder, with zero coding. Drop in an event calendar, wire up an RSVP form, and publish a full conference website the same afternoon.

Built for event organizers and web designers, this addon delivers everything a high-converting event website needs: a responsive event calendar with month, week, and list views, an event registration and RSVP form, a ticket listing and purchase widget, a conference schedule and agenda, a speaker grid, a countdown timer, and a location map. Every widget inherits your theme’s typography and colors and is fully responsive, so your event template stays pixel-perfect across desktop, tablet, and mobile.

Because each widget is a native Elementor element, you control layout, spacing, and styling in real time, no shortcodes to memorize and no developer to hire. Design your booking and ticketing sections to guide visitors straight to checkout, and lift event registrations and ticket sales by building the page around your call to action instead of fighting a rigid template.

Key Features

  • Native Elementor Widgets — every Eventin shortcode becomes a drag-and-drop Elementor widget you style visually.
  • Built for Conversions — design registration forms and ticket sales sections that drive sign-ups, not just display event data.
  • Fully Responsive Event Templates — every widget adapts to desktop, tablet, and mobile automatically.
  • No Coding Required — build a complete conference or webinar website without writing a line of code.
  • Real-Time Visual Editing — adjust colors, fonts, and layouts with Elementor’s live preview.
  • Theme-Friendly Styling — widgets inherit your active theme’s typography and color palette.

Widgets Included

  • Elementor Event Calendar Widget — month, week, and list views in a responsive layout.
  • Event Grid & List Display — show upcoming events in flexible grid or list formats.
  • Event Registration & RSVP Form — collect sign-ups and manage attendee capacity.
  • Ticket Listing & Purchase Widget — display ticket tiers and let visitors buy on the page.
  • Speaker Profile Grid — build speaker lineups and conference bios as styled cards.
  • Event Schedule & Agenda — lay out multi-session, multi-day conference schedules.
  • Event Countdown Timer — drive urgency toward your event start or registration deadline.
  • Event Location Map — embed an interactive venue map for in-person events.
  • Event Categories Filter — let visitors filter events by category or type.

Who Is This For?

This addon is perfect for anyone building event websites with Elementor and Eventin:

  • Event Planners & Organizers – Showcase upcoming events, sell tickets, and collect registrations – all designed visually in Elementor.
  • Conference & Summit Organizers – Build multi-session schedules, speaker lineups, and ticket tiers with pixel-perfect control.
  • Online Tutors & eLearning Creators – Display live classes, webinars, and workshop schedules alongside your course listings.
  • Webinar & Virtual Event Hosts – Create compelling landing pages for online events with Zoom or Google Meet links embedded seamlessly.
  • Meetup & Community Hosts – Set up RSVP event pages with attendee capacity indicators and location maps.
  • Corporate Trainers – Design structured training program pages with session schedules and registration forms.

Go Further with Eventin Pro

The free addon builds your event pages. Eventin Pro runs the event business behind them:

  • AI Event Creator — generate full event descriptions, FAQs, tags, and banners in under 10 seconds.
  • Custom Ticket Template Builder — design fully branded PDF event tickets that match your site.
  • Advanced Event Analytics — track registrations, ticket sales, and attendee data in one dashboard.
  • Recurring Events — schedule daily, weekly, monthly, or custom repeating events automatically.
  • Landing Page Builder — launch dedicated event landing pages from pre-built templates.
  • Multi-language Support — sell tickets and register attendees in any language.

👉 Upgrade to Eventin Pro

How It Works

  1. Install and activate Eventin + Elementor + this addon
  2. Open any page in Elementor’s editor
  3. Search for “Eventin” in the widget panel
  4. Drag your chosen widget onto the page
  5. Customize colors, fonts, layouts, and content in real-time
  6. Publish — your event page is live!

Seamless Integration

This addon works hand-in-hand with:

  • Eventin – The core event management plugin (required)
  • Elementor – The drag-and-drop page builder (required)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/eventin-elementor-addon directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure both Eventin and Elementor plugins are installed and activated.
  4. Open any page in Elementor and search for “Eventin” in the widget panel.
  5. Drag your chosen widget onto the page and start customizing!
sections.faq:
What is Eventin Addon for Elementor?

Eventin Addon for Elementor is a free WordPress plugin that turns the Eventin event management plugin into native drag-and-drop Elementor widgets. It lets you build event calendars, registration and RSVP forms, ticket sales sections, conference schedules, and speaker grids visually inside Elementor — with no coding required.

Do I need both Eventin and Elementor installed for this addon to work?

Yes. Eventin Addon for Elementor requires two free plugins: Eventin (the core event management plugin) and Elementor (the page builder). Once both are installed and activated, activate this addon and the Eventin widgets appear in Elementor’s widget panel when you search “Eventin.”

Is Eventin Addon for Elementor free?

Yes, Eventin Addon for Elementor is completely free on WordPress.org. All core widgets — event calendar, registration, RSVP, ticket listing, speaker cards, and schedule — work at no cost. A few widget options that surface Eventin Pro features require an Eventin Pro license.

How do I build an event website with Elementor and Eventin?

Install Eventin, Elementor, and Eventin Addon for Elementor, then open any page in the Elementor editor. Search “Eventin” in the widget panel, drag widgets such as Event Calendar, Registration Form, or Ticket Listing onto the canvas, style them in real time, and publish. A complete event landing page can be built in one session without code.

Can I sell event tickets with Elementor using this addon?

Yes. The Ticket Listing & Purchase widget displays your Eventin ticket tiers directly on an Elementor page and lets visitors buy without leaving it. Pair it with the Event Registration & RSVP form and the Countdown Timer to build a conversion-focused ticket sales page.

Which widgets are included in Eventin Addon for Elementor?

The free addon includes nine widgets: Event Calendar (month, week, and list views), Event Grid & List, Event Registration & RSVP Form, Ticket Listing & Purchase, Speaker Profile Grid, Event Schedule & Agenda, Event Countdown Timer, Event Location Map, and Event Categories Filter.

Can I use these widgets with the free version of Eventin?

Yes. Every core widget works with the free version of Eventin, including the event calendar, registration form, ticket listings, and speaker cards. Widgets that display Eventin Pro features — such as recurring events or custom ticket templates — require an Eventin Pro license.

Will the widgets work with my existing Elementor theme?

Yes. The widgets work with any Elementor-compatible WordPress theme. They inherit your theme’s typography and color settings automatically, and you can override fonts, colors, spacing, and layout for each widget directly in Elementor.

Do I need to know how to code to use this addon?

No. Eventin Addon for Elementor is built for event organizers and designers with no coding experience. Every widget is configured visually in Elementor’s interface — there are no shortcodes to write and no PHP, CSS, or HTML required.

Is Eventin Addon for Elementor compatible with the latest version of WordPress?

Yes. The addon is tested with WordPress 6.9 and the current version of Elementor. It requires WordPress 6.0 or higher and PHP 7.4 or higher.

What makes Eventin Addon for Elementor different from other Elementor event addons?

Unlike general-purpose Elementor widget packs, Eventin Addon for Elementor is purpose-built around a complete event management system. Its widgets connect directly to Eventin’s events, tickets, RSVPs, and attendee data, so your calendar, registration form, and ticket listings reflect live event data rather than static design placeholders.
